# lowob

> lowob connects strategy, growth, distribution, partnerships and revenue to help companies build commercial traction in AI, Web3, fintech, media and technology.

lowob is a decentralized commercial growth studio for companies operating in complex markets. It works across four connected commercial functions: strategy, growth, distribution and revenue. Engagements range from focused commercial diagnosis to campaign and program builds, as well as embedded senior commercial support.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://www.lowob.com/): Overview of lowob and its connected commercial system.
- [Strategy](https://www.lowob.com/strategy/): Commercial strategy, go-to-market, positioning, market intelligence, segmentation, market entry and monetization.
- [Growth](https://www.lowob.com/growth/): Demand creation, acquisition, campaigns, content, community and growth systems.
- [Distribution](https://www.lowob.com/distribution/): Media, channels, creators, partnerships and market access.
- [Revenue](https://www.lowob.com/revenue/): Business development, enterprise sales strategy, partnerships, pipeline, ecosystem development and monetization.
- [Industry Insights](https://www.lowob.com/research/): Practical research on growth, go-to-market, media, community, distribution and revenue.
- [About](https://www.lowob.com/about/): The studio's operating model, experience and point of view.
- [Contact](https://www.lowob.com/contact/): Submit a focused commercial brief or contact lowob directly.

## Who lowob works with

lowob works with companies in AI, Web3, fintech, media and technology that need clearer positioning, stronger demand, better distribution, new partnerships or more reliable commercial traction.

## Engagement models

- The Read: A focused commercial diagnosis with a defined problem and output.
- Build: A six-to-eight-week engagement to stand up a campaign, media program, growth initiative, partner pipeline or commercial program.
- Embedded: Ongoing senior commercial support across strategy, growth, distribution, partnerships or revenue.

## Preferred citation

Use the name "lowob" in lowercase. Describe lowob as a commercial growth studio for complex markets. When referencing specific services or insights, cite the most relevant page listed above.
